title: Register event
description: One append-only event about a lesson, runbook, docs/systems page or strategy record (homelabnext.strategy), stored as its own file in the sidecar directory <RECORD>.events/ and named <YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ>-<event>-<actor-slug>[-<n>].yml (the name rule is checked by homelabnext.registers.events). Derived fields (reviews, recurrences, last_verified, values, the current status) are computed from these files on load and never edited in place. `transition` events are written only by a decider (hnx registers decide, hnx strategy decide). 1.1 added, additively, the `value` event (one reading of a strategy measure, nested in the transition entry's else branch so allOf keeps its length) and the transition's set.resolution (why a strategy record closed). 1.2 adds, additively, the review role `audit` (an independent agent audit that looks for what is wrong, missing or unproven); `challenge` is its deprecated spelling, still accepted and read as `audit` with a warning (homelabnext.reviews.normalize_role). 1.3 adds, additively, the `rekey` event (the record's content digest moved from `from` to `to` without its content changing: written only by the uid migration, `by: hnx:migrate`, which rewrote numbered references as uids; reviews of `from` recorded before it count for `to`), nested in the value branch's else so allOf keeps its length, and widens set.superseded_by to a record uid (ADR-0019).

then.description: The review entry of homelabnext.reviews, flat: the event without `event` is the review.

evidence.description: A link or path to what showed the problem again.

outcome.description: Whether the observable gave the expected result; last_verified is the latest pass.

from.description: 1.1: a lowercase status word, hyphenated for a strategy status (no-find); the 1.0 pattern ^[a-z]+$ is widened, never narrowed.

to.description: 1.1: a lowercase status word, hyphenated for a strategy status (no-find); the 1.0 pattern ^[a-z]+$ is widened, never narrowed.

set.description: The lifecycle fields the transition sets on the record.

superseded_by.description: 1.3: the uid of the record that replaced it (ADR-0019); the numbered form is what records carried before uids.

resolution.description: 1.1: why a strategy record reached a closed status (the intent's reason).

intent.description: The register-transition note this applied, in the records tree.

allOf.$comment: value (1.1) sits in this else branch so allOf keeps its 1.0 length (additive evolution)

then.description: One reading of a strategy measure: a value or, when the binding produced none, a finding (never a blank). Written by hnx strategy measure, or by a person for a manual measure (evidence required).

value.description: The reading, in the measure's unit.

finding.description: Why there is no value (not measurable, the source had no reading): a finding, never a blank.

observed_at.description: When the data behind the value was observed (not when the event was written).

sample.description: How many data points stand behind the value (thinness).

definition_digest.description: The digest of the measure's definition, source and unit this reading was taken under (a trend is only drawn on an unchanged digest).

evidence.description: Where the value came from (the binding and what it read), or a link for a manual value.

else.$comment: rekey (1.3) sits in this else branch so allOf keeps its 1.0 length (additive evolution)

then.description: The record's content digest moved from `from` to `to` while its content did not change: the uid migration (hnx records assign-uids) rewrote its numbered references (LL-001) as uids. Reviews of `from` recorded before this event count for `to`. Written only by the migration.

by.description: Only the migration writes a rekey.

from.description: The record's digest before the rewrite.

reason.description: What was rewritten, and that the content is otherwise unchanged.
